title: Seven Days in York

pre.en: Why did the announcement at King's Cross say "Shane Taylor"?
pre.zh: 国王十字车站的广播为什么叫的是「Shane Taylor」？
options: The pub had changed Chen's name.
Tom had written that name on Chen's luggage label.

intro: 融汇课：一段旅行小结。小陈坐在回伦敦的火车上，说给朋友们听，把约克这一周的事挨个过一遍——背包、黄铜钟、Shane、相机、城墙。读的时候留意被动语态怎么混在一起用：was handed in、got renamed、is said to be、can be changed、had my photo taken。最后还有一条「更新」。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone, it's Chen.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是小陈。

sentences.en: We set off from Tom's parents' at three.
sentences.zh: 我们三点从 Tom 爸妈家出发。

sentences.en: Now I'm on board the four o'clock to London, in a seat that's actually mine.
sentences.zh: 现在我坐上了四点回伦敦的火车，这回坐的还真是我自己的座位。

sentences.en: Tom's fast asleep, so I'll fill you in on my week.
sentences.zh: Tom 睡得正香，那我给大家讲讲我这一周。

sentences.en: Don't worry, I'll keep it simple.
sentences.zh: 放心，我长话短说。

sentences.en: So, in seven days, my backpack was handed in without its sandwich.
sentences.zh: 七天里，我的背包被人交了回来，只是三明治没了。

sentences.en: I was sold a clock made in Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 有人卖给我一个深圳造的钟。

sentences.en: Honestly, I should never have asked, "How much do you want for it?"
sentences.zh: 说真的，我当初就不该问那句「这个您想卖多少？」

sentences.en: At the quiz, I got renamed Shane.
sentences.zh: 问答之夜，我被改名叫了 Shane。

sentences.en: My camera got "borrowed", and no, I wasn't asked.
sentences.zh: 我的相机被人「借」走了——对，没人问过我。

sentences.en: And thanks to Margaret, 212 drainpipes have been photographed.
sentences.zh: 多亏了 Margaret，足足拍了 212 根排水管。

sentences.en: But I made the most of every day.
sentences.zh: 不过，我每一天都过得很充实。

sentences.en: I got up first thing in the morning for Margaret's walk along the walls, and she explained every gate in detail.
sentences.zh: 我一大早就起床去参加 Margaret 的城墙徒步，每一座城门她都讲得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: I had my photo taken next to Mallard.
sentences.zh: 我请人给我在「野鸭号」旁边拍了张照。

sentences.en: I held a copy of a Viking shoe that's said to be a thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 我还拿过一只维京鞋的复制品，据说原物有一千年了。

sentences.en: And I learned that old buildings in York are protected by law.
sentences.zh: 我还知道了，约克的老房子是受法律保护的。

sentences.en: Not even a front door can be changed without permission.
sentences.zh: 没有许可，连一扇前门都不能换。

sentences.en: I'm tired but happy, and really sorry to leave.
sentences.zh: 我累是累，但很开心，真舍不得走。

sentences.en: I can't get over how much history fits into one small city.
sentences.zh: 一座小城装得下这么多历史，我到现在都觉得不可思议。

sentences.en: When I moved in with Tom, I had no idea he came from a place like this.
sentences.zh: 刚搬去跟 Tom 合租的时候，我完全不知道他是从这样一个地方来的。

sentences.en: In London, I walk past old buildings every day, and I've always taken them for granted.
sentences.zh: 在伦敦，我每天从老房子旁边走过，一直觉得理所当然。

sentences.en: Margaret's got me up to speed on York's drainpipes — and I never expected to say that.
sentences.zh: Margaret 让我把约克的排水管摸了个门儿清——这话我做梦都没想到自己会说。

sentences.en: My photos are being uploaded right now, so you'll see them on Monday.
sentences.zh: 照片现在正在上传，周一你们就能看到。

sentences.en: All in all, I've had the time of my life.
sentences.zh: 总之，这一周是我过得最开心的日子。

sentences.en: Quick update.
sentences.zh: 再更新一下。

sentences.en: It's 6:40, and I'm at King's Cross.
sentences.zh: 现在六点四十，我在国王十字车站。

sentences.en: As we got off, there was an announcement.
sentences.zh: 我们刚下车，就听到一条广播。

sentences.en: "Would passenger Shane Taylor please come to the information desk?"
sentences.zh: 「请乘客 Shane Taylor 到问讯处来一下。」

sentences.en: "Your backpack has been handed in."
sentences.zh: 「您的背包已经有人交上来了。」

sentences.en: Tom had written that name on my luggage label as a joke.
sentences.zh: 原来 Tom 开玩笑，在我的行李牌上写了这个名字。

sentences.en: So yes, I left it on the train.
sentences.zh: 没错，我把包落在火车上了。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又一次。

cards.note: to start a journey
cards.tip: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set；从哪里出发用 from，去哪里用 for：set off for London。
cards.example: We set off early to miss the traffic.

cards.zh: 在车上；在船上；在飞机上
cards.note: on or onto a train, ship or plane
cards.tip: 后面直接接交通工具，不加 of：on board the train。
cards.example: All passengers should now be on board.

cards.zh: 给某人讲讲情况；补上信息
cards.note: to tell someone the details of something they do not know yet
to do something in a simple way, without too many details

cards.zh: 上交；交给（失物招领、老师、前台）
cards.note: to give something to a person in charge, for example something you found or a piece of work

cards.text: how much do you want for sth?
cards.note: a question you ask a seller when you want to know the price and maybe pay less
cards.tip: 暗示价钱可以谈，市场和二手买卖常用；问的是卖家心里的价。
cards.example: "How much do you want for the sofa?" "Fifty, but I'm open to offers."

cards.note: re- 表示「重新」：rewrite 重写、rebuild 重建；程序员常说 rename a file。
当动词比 take a photo of 正式；重音在第一个音节。
to use or enjoy something as much as possible while you can
cards.tip: 常用于时间、机会、好天气；most 前面一定有 the。
cards.example: It's sunny today, so let's make the most of it.

cards.note: very early in the morning, before you do anything else
including all the facts and small parts of something
to feel sad because you have to go away from a place or people you like
cards.tip: 这里的 sorry 是「难过、遗憾」，不是道歉；be sorry to hear sth 是「听到……很难过」。
cards.example: We had a great time here, and we're sorry to leave.

cards.zh: （惊讶得）想不通；还没回过神来
cards.note: to be very surprised by something and keep thinking about it
cards.tip: 后面常接 how 从句或名词：I can't get over the view；get over sth 单用是「从（病、失恋）中恢复」。
cards.example: I can't get over how cheap the flat was.

cards.note: to start living in a new home
to not know something at all

cards.zh: 认为……理所当然（因而不在意）
cards.note: to not notice or value something because it is always there
cards.tip: 东西放在 take 和 for granted 中间；take 的过去分词 taken：have taken it for granted。
cards.example: We often take clean water for granted.

cards.zh: 让某人跟上进度；让某人了解最新情况
cards.note: to give someone all the information they need so they can work like everyone else
cards.tip: 人放在 get 和 up to speed 中间；关于什么用 on：up to speed on the new system。
cards.example: Can you get me up to speed on the project before the meeting?

cards.note: 反义词 download（下载）；名词也是 upload。
used to give a general opinion after thinking about every part of something

cards.text: have the time of your life
cards.zh: 过得特别开心；度过最快乐的时光
cards.note: to enjoy yourself very much
cards.tip: your 要随人变：my / their life；常用现在完成时或过去时说一段经历。
cards.example: The kids had the time of their lives at the beach.

cards.note: 动词 announce；车站、机场的广播都叫 announcement。
广播里常把 passenger 直接放在名字前面，像头衔一样。
不可数，不说 a luggage；一件行李是 a piece of luggage。
英式读音 /ˈleɪbl/；衣服上的标签、文件夹上的标签都叫 label。
